items.title: "Pete" Ferdinand Valentine Interview, 1960-06-24
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] What about people like Freddy Keppert and Manuel Perez and Buddy Bolden and Joe Alton? Did you hear those guys? [INTERVIEWEE] Well, I didn't get to see him.

ctx.x: He was good by ear? Oh yeah, he kicked anything. He's hard to line with you, but after, you know, I just come just like that overnight. Take all the pieces and give it to everybody and tell them what to do.
What about people like Freddy Keppert and Manuel Perez and Buddy Bolden and Joe Alton? Did you hear those guys?
Well, I didn't get to see him. I didn't get to see him on the parade, Manuel.
